reviewer_statement: Developer-side six-domain scientific source comparison of the Python 1.2 stabilized-volatility selector, its input/error policy, first qualifying r+1 stable transitions, target-specific null selections, output schema and provenance. native_language_semantic_policy: Native R validated scientific list/matrix representation of Python's frozen scan/selection dataclasses and NumPy arrays; finite source-produced matrices and source-matched numeric/Boolean fields, without Python runtime object identity.

case_evidence.description: Frozen wild_selection.py selector with required positive width and center thresholds, integer stability run and explicit error/warn/ignore policy; native source-shaped scan input.
Consecutive candidate-component and complete target matrices produced by the source wild-bootstrap scanner; positive scalar and decimal-text thresholds, and source target-specific selection.
Exact successive absolute width and center changes, inclusive threshold comparisons, r+1 runs, first stable candidate index, and NaN retention for targets with no valid stable run.

Zero, nonfinite and invalid thresholds, invalid stability counts, absent consecutive runs, malformed matrices and invalid failure options. Too-large R stability counts fail cleanly before 32-bit overflow.
Complete frozen typed Python selection result fields, all shape-stable Boolean and numeric matrices, original scan record, zero-based indices, missing selection values, and full nested provenance.
Targetwise earliest stabilized-volatility inference truncation selected without a largest-h fallback, no re-fitting and no bootstrap draws; width/center thresholds in original outcome units.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed source evidence committed; exact-head CI pending; 0 independent scientific certifications.
